messages:
alex: quick question — can we settle a small surface contract? we keep leaking too much internal jargon in client errors. 429 vs 503 behavior is messy.
maria: +1. high-level rule: 4xx = client problem (quota/usage), 5xx = server/degrade. but we need guidance for soft-degrades that still return 200.
sam: agree. also need a consistent retry header. HTTP Retry-After is fine for hard throttles, but what about when we do auto-fallbacks to cheaper models?
alex: example payload i keep seeing from support:
```json
{ "error": "quota_exceeded_internal_limit_v2_beta", "status": 429, "details": "pool=dedicated-3" }
```
that string is useless to customers and leaks infra names.
jen: please don't expose internal names. propose two-layer surface: public_code + human_message. e.g. {"code":"Q_LIMIT","message":"Quota exceeded"} and console shows expanded details for owners.
maria: propose codes: Q_LIMIT, RATE_LIMIT, FALLBACK_APPLIED, SERVER_DEGRADED. short, stable, uppercase.
emily: need to think about i18n: human_message should be localizable; code should be stable key consumed by SDKs and dashboards.
sam: telemetry ask: every error we emit should include telemetry tags: routing_policy, error_bucket, model_variant, route_id. then console can map code -> details.
alex: UI copy draft for console banner: "Request volume is high — some requests are being rate-limited or routed to fallback models. Check usage and routing policies in the dashboard." short + link.
jen: for API surface, example recommended error for client quota:
```json
{ "status":429, "code":"Q_LIMIT", "message":"Quota exceeded. Reduce concurrency or request more capacity.", "retry_after":60 }
```
keep retry_after numeric and machine-friendly.
maria: about soft-fallbacks: i suggest returning 200 with code FALLBACK_APPLIED and an X-Redwood-Fallback header. that lets clients detect degraded quality without treating as an error.
sam: hmm backwards compat concern: some clients expect 2xx == success and won't check body codes. header is safer: X-Redwood-Fallback: model=redwood-lite;quality=degraded
alex: for hard failures we should include a retry_hint field (machine-readable) and a short user_hint for console. e.g. retry_hint: "backoff|60" vs user_hint: "Try again in a minute or lower batch size."
jen: please avoid long user_hint strings in API responses — keep them short and surface full guidance in docs/console.
emily: remember i18n: user_hint in API should be english only; console will map code -> localized message.
alex: action items summarized: (1) define public code taxonomy (Q_LIMIT, RATE_LIMIT, FALLBACK_APPLIED, SERVER_DEGRADED, CANCELLED), (2) add telemetry keys (routing_policy,error_bucket,route_id,model_variant), (3) standardize retry_after and retry_hint, (4) header for fallback X-Redwood-Fallback, (5) console copy examples and i18n plan.
sam: owner volunteers? alex (codes + API shape), jen (console copy + UI constraints), maria (telemetry mapping), emily (i18n). timeline: one-week RFC draft?
alex: i'll put a short RFC in docs and paste samples. aiming EOD Friday.
maria: i'll add telemetry schema to the RFC too.
jen: will prototype small banner texts and collapse/expand console detail patterns.
deploy-bot: rollout job 512 started: docs space created: /docs/rfc/error-surface-1717777000
emily: cool. tagging @product for awareness later.
sam: sounds good. thanks all :thumbsup:
alex: thanks — keeping client surface small and stable is priority.
